text:
Emma: Hey team — quick ask for the Feb 9 webinar. Need final bench numbers (latency p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, cost-per-1k) and a 3-line methodology blurb we can paste into slides. Can runtime provide a smoke rerun today? cc @Raj @Nikhil

Raj: Can do. Which model variants do you need (fp16, int8, int8-quantized-faster)? Also what's the sample prompt mix — short chat, multi-turn, long instruction?

Nikhil: We have the last run data in s3: s3://redwood-bench/webinar/2026-02-06/. There are CSVs for each variant. If you want a fresh smoke, give me a 2-hour window.

Emma: Short chat (1-3 turns) + a few 1k-token long generation samples. Prioritize int8 and fp16. Short blurb should mention 'steady-state traffic, synthetic prompts, 95/99 tail capture'.

Raj: OK. I'll schedule a quick smoke on the int8 and fp16 profiles. Will capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, and token cost using our unit-cost script.

Nikhil: Command I'll run:
```
./bench/run_smoke.sh --models gpt-like-fp16,gpt-like-int8 --profiles short-chat,long-gen --out s3://redwood-bench/webinar/2026-02-09-smoke/
```
I need confirmation on concurrency and env (hosted vs dedicated).

Tessa: For the webinar narrative we want hosted numbers + a note that Dedicated has predictable throughput. Could you include both if it's easy? Otherwise hosted is fine.

Raj: We'll do hosted baseline and attach a one-line note about Dedicated. For concurrency use 8 threads for short-chat and 2 for long-gen. That should reflect demo traffic.

Olivia: Remember to strip user prompt text before sharing. Also include p95/p99 per-route breakdown if available. If you're uploading CSVs, add a small README.

deploy-bot: Scheduled bench job 1945679000 by Raj — status: queued

Nikhil: started smoke now, ETA ~20m. Uploading to s3 path above when done.

Emma: Amazing. Could you also give 1-sentence on methodology for the slide (e.g., 'Synthetic traffic representing chat and long completion; reported p50/p95/p99 over 5-minute steady-state windows; cost computed from per-token runtime billing')

Raj: I'll add that exact line. Target: we need results in 1hr so marketing can lock slides.

Nikhil: Smoke complete. Uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/webinar/2026-02-09-smoke/results-summary.csv. Quick note: int8 shows ~12% cost saving vs fp16 on these payloads.

Emma: Perfect, thanks!! :tada: I'll draft slides and ping if we need clarification.

Tessa: I'll review the slide blurb once Emma posts.
